topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can't believe you were doing that, pretending all along. I mean, I always thought your stories sounded a bit... off, but I never wanted to think the worst. I guess I was so caught up in how happy I was for you, I didn’t stop to question. I know things are tough out there, and maybe you felt like you had to do this to feel better or to keep up with the rest of us. I just wish you’d reached out, really. We’re all struggling in our own ways, and it’s okay to talk about it. I’m here, you know? I just want us to be real with each other, no masks.
